data.long_meaning: The meaning of Michell is recorded in name-lists as “Who is like God?”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Michell expresses “Who is like God?”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Michell total 35, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material mastery.

in_hebrew.name: מִחֶיל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: This name is derived from the Hebrew word mīchēl, meaning ‘who is like God?’ It is a powerful reminder of God’s supremacy and sovereignty over all things.

in_greek.name: Μιχαήλ
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Michell in Greek is written as Mιχαήλ. The Greek form of the name is derived from the Hebrew mīchēl, meaning ‘who is like God?’ It is the name of the archangel Michael.

in_latin.name: Michael
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Michell in Latin is Michael, derived from the Hebrew mīchēl. The name means ‘who is like God?’ It is the name of the archangel Michael in Christian tradition.

biblical_reference.note: In the Old Testament book of Micah, we read about the coming of a ruler from Bethlehem, who will be called ‘Mighty God,’ and whose origins are traced back to the ancient patriarchs. The name Michell is a powerful reminder of God’s sovereignty and His plan for salvation.
